scripts.title: Fe send message to console everyone can see
scripts.features:
allows you to send messages to the console (everyone can see) and the message can be anything

dont make it too long or it will kick you out

sometimes it doesn't work on some games idk why
scripts.script:
-- allows you to send a message on the dev console (everyone can see) it can be any text

local local_player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local animate = local_player.Character.Animate
local idle_anim = animate.idle.Animation1

local old_animid = idle_anim.AnimationId
animate.Enabled = true
idle_anim.AnimationId = "active://skibidi ohio rizz maximum aura" -- text here, dont delete the activate://
task.wait()
animate.Enabled = false
animate.Enabled = true
idle_anim.AnimationId = old_animid
task.wait()
animate.Enabled = false
animate.Enabled = true
